def find_kth_permutation(n, k):
    from math import factorial
    
    # Helper function to generate the next permutation in lexicographic order
    def next_permutation(arr):
        i = len(arr) - 2
        while i >= 0 and arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]:
            i -= 1
        if i == -1:
            return False
        j = len(arr) - 1
        while arr[j] <= arr[i]:
            j -= 1
        arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
        arr[i + 1:] = reversed(arr[i + 1:])
        return True

    perm = list(range(1, n + 1))
    
    # Skip the first k-1 permutations
    for _ in range(k - 1):
